thesis: The podcast introduces Todd Finkel, a professor of entrepreneurship at Gonzaga University and author of the new book 'Warren Buffett: Investor and Entrepreneur,' which offers a unique perspective by focusing on Buffett's entrepreneurial side rather than just his investing. Finkel explains that his path to writing the book began when a professor at the University of Wisconsin-Madison suggested he pursue a PhD in entrepreneurship, noting that the field was not yet popular before he earned his degree in 1993.
